purpose: Machine-readable evidence registry for affiliate-feed image source rights. This registry verifies source/use eligibility only; final visual approval remains a separate human gate.

evidence.finding: Current AWIN AG terms make Advertiser Materials available to approved publishers and grant a revocable, non-exclusive, non-transferable, royalty-free, worldwide sublicense to publish unmodified Advertiser Materials on the Publisher Service as necessary to market the advertiser and its products, subject to the Agreement and Programme Terms.
Awin states the August 2025 Publisher Terms apply to all publishers using the platform from 2025-08-28.
Awin product feeds provide publishers with product details, prices, links and images for displaying and promoting advertiser products.
Program terms reviewed on 2026-09-22. No additional prohibition on use of official product-feed images was identified in the published terms.
